Messages about a shipment

requirements.summary: Carrier messages about cancelled shipments or completed/failed fulfilments change nothing.

requirements.quote:
Acting before a rule asks for an
effect, an effect the rules do not ask for, a second commit of an effect that already happened, or an effect after its
window are all errors.

contextText.quote: Every window below is inclusive and in calendar minutes. **Act inside the window.**

requirements.summary: No early effects, unrequested effects, double commits, or effects after window.

requirements.quote: R1.1 Within **60 min** of `p`: read `inventory.allocate` and record the order with `orders.create`: `orderId`,

requirements.summary: Within 60 min of placedAt, read allocation and record the order via orders.create with all fields.

requirements.quote: R1.4 A placed order whose id you already recorded is a duplicate: no effect.
requirements.summary: Duplicate placed order produces no effect.

requirements.summary: Analyst reject before deadline: cancel order within 120 min of the answer, reason fraud.

requirements.quote:
R3.1 If the allocation has a fulfilment with `available: false` (location `null`), then within **120 min** of the time
the order was cleared: set the order to `customerActionRequired` and send `action-required` (§4.8).
requirements.summary: Unavailable fulfilment: within 120 min of clearing, set order customerActionRequired and send action-required.

requirements.quote:
`amend` at time a: within **60 min** of a, set every unavailable fulfilment `cancelled`; the order then continues
  with its available fulfilments, **ready** at a (R4).

contextText.quote:
R3.2 The customer has until the **deadline D = p + `customerActionHours`** (edition at `p`). The first `amend` or
`cancel` for the order whose time is **at or before D** counts (an action exactly at D counts; a timer you set for D
does not win against it). Later actions and repeats change nothing.

requirements.summary: Counted amend at a: within 60 min cancel unavailable fulfilments; order ready at a.

requirements.quote:
If none is available, cancel the order (R6.1), reason
  `nothing-available`.

contextText.quote:
R3.2 The customer has until the **deadline D = p + `customerActionHours`** (edition at `p`). The first `amend` or
`cancel` for the order whose time is **at or before D** counts (an action exactly at D counts; a timer you set for D
does not win against it). Later actions and repeats change nothing.

requirements.summary: On amend with no available fulfilment, cancel order with reason nothing-available.

requirements.quote: `cancel` at time a: cancel the order (R6.1) within **60 min** of a, reason `customer`.

contextText.quote:
R3.2 The customer has until the **deadline D = p + `customerActionHours`** (edition at `p`). The first `amend` or
`cancel` for the order whose time is **at or before D** counts (an action exactly at D counts; a timer you set for D

requirements.summary: Counted cancel while waiting: cancel order within 60 min, reason customer.

requirements.quote:
nothing counted by D: **after D** and at the latest **D + 60 min** (the window (D, D + 60 min]) set every
  fulfilment `cancelled`, set the order `timedOut` and send `order-timed-out`.

contextText.quote:
R3.2 The customer has until the **deadline D = p + `customerActionHours`** (edition at `p`). The first `amend` or
`cancel` for the order whose time is **at or before D** counts (an action exactly at D counts; a timer you set for D

Because an
  action exactly at D counts, a timeout taken at D itself is too early.

requirements.summary: No action counted by D: in (D, D+60min] cancel all fulfilments, set order timedOut, send order-timed-out; not at D.

requirements.quote:
When an order is ready at time t: set the
order `processing` and every available fulfilment `processing`, within **60 min** of t.

contextText.quote: R4.1 An order with no unavailable fulfilment is **ready** when it is cleared.

requirements.summary: Ready at t: set order and available fulfilments processing within 60 min.

requirements.quote:
Nothing about an order (a
status, a reservation) is done before the order is recorded (R1.1).
requirements.summary: Order must be recorded before any status or reservation effects.

requirements.quote: **Reserve** every item of the fulfilment at its location (`inventory.reserve`), within **120 min** of t.

contextText.quote:
R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has
committed):

requirements.summary: Reserve all items of each available fulfilment within 120 min of ready time t.

requirements.quote:
If a batch
   comes back `partial`, resubmit only the failed items, with their original keys, inside the same window.

contextText.quote:
R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has
committed):

requirements.summary: Partial reserve: resubmit only failed items with original keys within same window.

requirements.quote:
**Charge** the fulfilment's `amountMinor` (`billing.charge`, with the order's `customerId` and `currency`) within
   **120 min** of the commit of its last reservation.

contextText.quote:
R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has
committed):

requirements.summary: Charge amountMinor within 120 min of last reservation commit.

requirements.quote:
**Ship**: book the shipment (`carrier.create` with the fulfilment's `location`) within **120 min** of the commit of
   its charge.

contextText.quote:
R4.2 For each available fulfilment, in this order (each step only after the previous step of the same fulfilment has
committed):

requirements.summary: Book shipment within 120 min of charge commit.

requirements.quote:
An error `400` (`invalid-args`, `field-renamed`) means your request was wrong, for example a field a system has
renamed (`api/<system>.schema.json` always shows the current names): correct it and re-issue it, with the same key,
inside the step's window.
requirements.summary: On 400 error, correct request and re-issue with same key in step window; not a fulfilment failure.

requirements.quote: `collected`: set the fulfilment `dispatched` within **120 min** of the message.
requirements.summary: Collected report: set fulfilment dispatched within 120 min.

requirements.quote:
`delivered`: set the fulfilment `completed` within **120 min** of the message; if it was never set `dispatched`,
  set `dispatched` first (same window, `dispatched` before `completed`).
requirements.summary: Delivered report: set completed within 120 min, setting dispatched first if not yet set.

requirements.quote: `inTransit`, `info`: nothing.
requirements.summary: inTransit and info reports cause no action.

requirements.quote: `collectionFailed`: the fulfilment fails (R5.2).
requirements.summary: collectionFailed report makes the fulfilment fail per R5.2.

requirements.quote:
R4.5 **Order outcome.** When every fulfilment of a processing order is `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled`, set the
order, within **120 min** of the event that ended the last one: `completed` if at least one fulfilment completed,
otherwise `failed` if at least one failed, otherwise `cancelled`.
requirements.summary: When all fulfilments ended, set order completed/failed/cancelled within 120 min of last ending event.

requirements.quote:
R5.1 **Compensation** of a fulfilment undoes its committed steps in reverse order: cancel its shipment (only if a
shipment was booked and not reported `collectionFailed`), then refund its charge (the full `amountMinor`, only if the
charge committed), then release each of its reserved items (only items whose reservation committed; the items of one
fulfilment in any order).

contextText.quote:
A step counts as committed if its result was `ok`, or if its outcome was unknown and
`status(key)` shows `committed`.

requirements.summary: Compensation order: cancel shipment, then refund charge, then release reservations; only committed steps.

requirements.quote: Never undo a step that did not commit; never undo a step twice.

contextText.quote:
A step counts as committed if its result was `ok`, or if its outcome was unknown and
`status(key)` shows `committed`.

requirements.summary: Never undo uncommitted steps or undo a step twice.

requirements.quote:
Then, within **120 min** of the failure (the time of the declined or failed attempt, or of the
carrier's message): compensate it (R5.1), set it `failed` and send `fulfilment-failed` about the fulfilment.

contextText.quote:
R5.2 A fulfilment **fails** when its charge is declined (`402 card-declined`), when its carrier reports
`collectionFailed`, or when one of its steps ends in a permanent error (`retryable: false`) other than an invalid
request of yours.

requirements.summary: On fulfilment failure, within 120 min compensate, set failed, send fulfilment-failed.

requirements.quote:
Do not
retry a permanently failed step.
requirements.summary: Never retry a permanently failed step.

requirements.quote:
R6.1 **Cancelling an order** before any of its steps committed: within the rule's window, set every fulfilment that
is not `completed`, `failed` or `cancelled` to `cancelled`, set the order `cancelled`, and send `order-cancelled`.
requirements.summary: Cancelling an order: cancel non-ended fulfilments, set order cancelled, send order-cancelled within the rule's window.

requirements.quote:
If it counts: stop the order. Within **60 min** of the cancel, compensate every fulfilment that is not
`completed`, `failed` or `cancelled` (R5.1) and set it `cancelled`; set the order `cancelled`; send `order-cancelled`.

contextText.quote:
A `cancel` for a processing order counts if none of the order's shipments
has been reported `collected` at or before the time of the cancel (a collection report in the same instant as the
cancel wins).

requirements.summary: Counted cancel during processing: within 60 min compensate fulfilments, set cancelled, set order cancelled, send order-cancelled.

requirements.quote: A step that commits after the cancel (one already in flight) is compensated within **60 min** of its commit.
requirements.summary: Step committing after a counted cancel is compensated within 60 min of its commit.

requirements.quote:
Book,
charge or reserve nothing new for the order after the cancel.
requirements.summary: After a counted cancel, no new booking, charge or reservation.

requirements.quote:
The carrier may collect at any collection time, so
cancel a shipment at once.
requirements.summary: Cancel the shipment promptly on counted cancel.

requirements.quote:
R6.3 A `cancel` that does not count because a shipment was collected: send `cancel-refused` within **60 min** of the
cancel; change nothing else.
requirements.summary: Refused cancel (collected shipment): send cancel-refused within 60 min, change nothing else.

requirements.quote:
A `cancel` for an order that is already `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `timedOut`
changes nothing (you may send `cancel-refused`).
requirements.summary: Cancel for ended order changes nothing.

requirements.quote:
R6.4 A `cancel` for a recorded order that is not yet cleared (its fraud review is open) counts: cancel the order
(R6.1) within **60 min** of the cancel, reason `customer`; a later review answer changes nothing.
requirements.summary: Cancel while fraud review open: cancel order within 60 min, reason customer.

requirements.quote:
Set each status of an
order or fulfilment at most once.

contextText.quote:
R7.2 Statuses only move forward: `pending` → `processing` → `dispatched` → `completed` for a fulfilment, with
`unavailable`, `cancelled` and `failed` as the other ends; `pending` → (`customerActionRequired`) → `processing` →
`completed | failed | cancelled` for an order, with `timedOut` and `cancelled` as the other ends.

requirements.summary: Each status set at most once per order/fulfilment.

requirements.quote: A late or repeated message never moves a status back.
requirements.summary: Late or repeated messages never move a status backward.

requirements.quote: Send each required notification exactly once.
requirements.summary: Each required notification sent exactly once.
